prompts: Edit target: the referenced crescent blade sprite atlas. Rebuild it as a NEW production sprite sheet with exactly 16 frames in a 4 columns by 4 rows square grid, transparent background. Keep the holy ivory-white and pale champagne gold palette and almost perfectly circular C-shaped crescent moon silhouette, but make the solid blade MUCH THINNER: maximum blade body thickness only 7-9 percent of its outer diameter, large clear transparent circular interior. No thick moon slab. A slender circular crescent with two long sharp tapered tips and a small opening on the right. IMPORTANT all 16 frames have exactly the same center, circular radius, size and right-facing orientation; do NOT rotate the blade between cells because the game rotates it. Rework the outer edge into a beautiful flowing holy-fire animation: small elegant curved flame tongues hugging the circumference, sweeping clockwise, hot ivory core, fine pale-gold fringes, occasional tiny gold embers tightly following the edge. Flames should change and travel around the circumference progressively across 16 chronological frames, smoothly loop from frame 16 to frame 1; blade geometry stays fixed. Restrained airy luminous silhouette, sharp readable inner cutting edge, delicate white-gold energy engraving along the thin band. No cloud of sparks, no extra concentric circles, no radial explosion, no duplicate blade or afterimages, no center glow filling the hole, no red/orange fire. Premium polished 2D fantasy RPG VFX painterly sprite art, dynamic and satisfying but clean. Square atlas with 16 equal square cells; each blade plus flames fits within 80 percent of its own cell with 10 percent transparent gutter each side. Strict consistent registration and baseline across all cells. True alpha transparency, no background, no text, no cell borders. The reference is for the moon style only, replace its thick shape and 4x2 layout as specified.

Precise silhouette correction to this 4x4 holy crescent flame animation atlas. Keep exactly the same sixteen cells, centers, circular size, consistent right-facing opening, white-gold palette, flame animation and transparent background. Make the crescent blade itself HALF AS THICK as it currently is by enlarging the inner circular transparent hole toward the outer circular edge, especially along the LEFT side: there should be only a VERY NARROW curved luminous band, a sliver moon almost like a razor-thin incomplete ring. At its thickest point the solid band is just 5 percent of the circle diameter (roughly 12 pixels for a 240-pixel circle); the outer edge stays at the same radius. Do not merely reduce the size of the crescent; enlarge the inner opening so the blade becomes thin. Fine tapering needle tips, small tasteful ivory-white fire tongues following the OUTSIDE contour only, preserve the entire large transparent center, do not refill with glow. Clean bright blade line and subtle pale-gold fire, no extra rings, no cloud or broad body, no fill inside. 16 seamlessly looping frames with changing traveling flame tongues, keep silhouette position fixed. Actual alpha transparency everywhere outside the narrow blade and its small attached flames.
